title: Messenger of the Gods · Cross-Domain Conduit

route.returns: Delivery confirmation — routes output to all relevant Titan memory domains

delivery.returns: Delivery stats for a specific Titan's memory

translation_maps.built_in: Hermes reads each Olympian's domain.json translations field at runtime
translation_maps.note: Translation maps are defined in each Olympian's domain.json, not in Hermes. Hermes reads and applies them.

memory_ingestion.note: Each Titan's memory is stored in localStorage under their ID. Kronos also receives a copy of every routing event as the master ledger.

integration.purpose: Critical plumbing — without Hermes, Olympians cannot write to Titan memory
